tooltip.golems_arsenal.shen_tong_staff: Grants +10% attack damage per Black Monkey upgrade installed
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_energy.desc: Adds FE capacity; capacity increases with upgrade level.
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_energy_tech: While holding the katana: powered hits trigger a lightning chain that applies Weakness and can repeat hits on the same target
While holding the hammer: reduces incoming damage by a fixed amount
While holding the bow: powered arrows explode on hit, converting projectile damage into explosion damage
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_weapon_main: Swords, axes, the flame sword and the forge hammer deal extra damage equal to a percentage of the golem's max health; the flame sword leaves a magic flame cloud on hit
Sword-tag weapons also grant +1 entity reach and +1 sweep range
Golem spears splash area damage around the struck target, and the sculk golem scythe deals bonus damage
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_weapon_rang: Arrows shot by a golem bow fly faster, raising arrow damage through the vanilla velocity damage formula; holding the Sonic Cannon (Echo Cannon) boosts magic damage
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_weapon_shie: Successful blocks restore shield durability based on the golem's armor and toughness, on a cooldown
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_weapon_onsl: While armor exceeds the threshold, each excess armor point plus toughness grants melee attack and percentage TACZ gun damage (configurable)
upgrade.golems_arsenal.tech_expansion.de: Each level grants 1 extra upgrade slot but reduces max health by 10%
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_scroll.desc: Right-click a golem holding this upgrade with a scroll to record a spell; the golem casts it in combat (requires Golem Magicka)
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_death_explo: When the golem dies it explodes once without breaking blocks, dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of its max health
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_stance.desc: Attacking, moving and being hurt fill the stance gauge; a full gauge grants one stance stack. Melee attacks consume all stacks for magic damage proportional to the hit, and arrows carry the stacks into magic damage on hit (works better with the Shen Tong Staff)
Level 1: up to 3 stacks, flame particles around the golem show the current count
Level 2: stack cap raised to 4, completing the flame particle ring
Requires Black Monkey: Stance; attacks absorbed by invulnerability frames grant one stance point
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_graze.desc: When a projectile grazes the golem, it briefly gains attack speed and short invulnerability
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_train.desc:
Each nearby mechanical golem increases its own damage (up to five golems counted), shares damage taken with nearby mechanical golems, and makes them more likely to be attacked
Mechanical golems need fuel in hand (or inventory)
message.golems_arsenal.stance_charge: Stance charged (%s stacks), next attack is empowered!
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_katana.cos: Powered hits consume %s FE and grant Charge
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_katana.cha: Powered hits grant Charge to the holder for %s seconds
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_hammer.def: Damage above %s%% of max HP consumes energy to reduce it by %s%%
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_hammer.reg: Restores %s%% max HP per second per tech level
tooltip.golems_arsenal.tracking_bow.trac: Powered arrows track the golem's target
